extracted.name: Blue Cheese Bites
extracted.description: Biscuits fly off the platter under normal circumstances. Here, they’re an even more decadent hit with a sprinkle of butter and blue cheese.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9-inch pie plate with nonstick cooking spray.
Slice each biscuit into quarters and arrange them in the prepared pie plate. Pour melted butter over biscuits, then sprinkle with blue cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
